# The Conversation

> > Independent academic journalism providing research-based analysis and expert commentary on current affairs, science, health, education, and policy issues across global editions.

The Conversation is a global network of nonprofit media outlets publishing articles written by academics and researchers from universities including University of Essex, Queen's University Belfast, University of Johannesburg, and others. With editions in Australia, UK, US, France, Africa, and Brasil, it bridges the gap between academia and the public through evidence-based journalism on topics ranging from climate change and education to politics and health.

## Key Topics

- Academic journalism
- Climate change and environment
- Education policy and pedagogy
- Mental health and crisis intervention
- Police training and de-escalation
- Australian politics and policy
- Public health and medicine
- International relations
- Science communication
- University research
- Community standards and moderation
- Environmental protection
- Social media in education
- Coronial inquests
- Global editions (Australia, UK, US, France, Africa, Brasil)

## About The Conversation

- [About us | The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/global/who-we-are): Global about page: academic journalism mission, editorial standards
- [The Conversation: In-depth analysis, research, news and ideas from leading academics and researchers.](https://theconversation.com/au): Australian homepage: academic analysis of current affairs and research
- [Our Team: The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/au/team): Editorial team profiles for The Conversation Australia and New Zealand

## Health and Medicine

- [Health + Medicine – The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/us/health): US health section: medical research, public health, pandemic preparedness
- [Tyler Cassidy inquest – police and community need better mental health training](https://theconversation.com/tyler-cassidy-inquest-police-and-community-need-better-mental-health-training-4459): Coroner Coate rules on Melbourne police shooting, calls for mental health training
- [Monday's medical myth: eating carrots will improve your eyesight](https://theconversation.com/mondays-medical-myth-eating-carrots-will-improve-your-eyesight-3458): Debunking carrot vision myth: vitamin A's role in eye health explained

## Education and Learning

- [Education – Views & Research – The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/uk/education): UK education coverage: social media policy, mental health, AI in schools
- [Education – Views & Research – The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/africa/education): Africa education section: higher ed, teaching methods, student wellbeing
- [Use your brain and teach children to read properly](https://theconversation.com/use-your-brain-and-teach-children-to-read-properly-3579): Brain research supports phonics-based literacy instruction in Australia

## Climate and Environment

- [Climate – Views & Research – The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/africa/climate): Africa climate coverage: carbon offsets, solar power, renewable energy
- [Environnement – The Conversation France](https://theconversation.com/fr/environnement): French environment section: biodiversity, nuclear energy, ecosystems
- [Does the Coral Sea marine park proposal provide enough protection?](https://theconversation.com/does-the-coral-sea-marine-park-proposal-provide-enough-protection-4474): Analyzing Coral Sea marine reserve proposal and fishing regulations

## Politics and World Affairs

- [World – Views & Research – The Conversation](https://theconversation.com/uk/world): UK world news: Iran conflict, Trump foreign policy, international relations
- [Speaker Slipper slips in as Gillard claims a tactical victory](https://theconversation.com/speaker-slipper-slips-in-as-gillard-claims-a-tactical-victory-4453): Harry Jenkins resigns as Speaker; Peter Slipper appointed in hung parliament
- [Emergency Management at the cabinet table long overdue](https://theconversation.com/emergency-management-at-the-cabinet-table-long-overdue-4710): Gillard cabinet reshuffle elevates emergency management amid climate threats
- [House-brand push boils down to capitalism's crisis](https://theconversation.com/house-brand-push-boils-down-to-capitalisms-crisis-4467): Heinz CEO criticizes private-label brands in Australian supermarkets

## Science and Philosophy

- [Black holes might exist, but let's stay sceptical](https://theconversation.com/black-holes-might-exist-but-lets-stay-sceptical-4238): Questioning black hole evidence: event horizons and astrophysics skepticism
- [Looking backwards and forwards – is that what makes us human?](https://theconversation.com/looking-backwards-and-forwards-is-that-what-makes-us-human-3981): Exploring human consciousness, temporal awareness, and animal cognition
